purpose: Preserve internal editorial findings separately from public event descriptions, with explicit resolution workflow.

status_definitions.open: Requires source research or factual clarification
status_definitions.blocked: No reliable evidence yet; do not invent facts

issues.evidence: User screenshot shows publicly visible internal caveat: 'העמוד אינו מפרט את אופיו המדויק של האירוע' and editorial advice to verify details.
editorial_questions: מה סוג האירוע בפועל: הצגה, מופע מוזיקלי, הרצאה או פעילות אחרת?
האם משך האירוע, מחיר הכרטיסים והפרטים האחרים מאומתים?
required_actions: Preserve original public text and source URLs in audit before any replacement
Research primary event-specific source and additional credible source where necessary
Move internal caveats to internal review record, not public description
Publish only independently verified public-facing copy
Confirm updated text is visible on public page and close issue with evidence

rules: Never delete editorial observations merely because they are unsuitable for public display.
Track each issue by event ID or stable URL, status, evidence, required actions, and resolution.
Public copy and editorial investigation notes must be separate fields.
Do not mark resolved without verifying live public page and preserving original observation.
